model_digest.description: SHA-256 hash of a canonical model identifier (e.g. provider:model_name:version).

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonicalised inference input. Raw input is NEVER sent to Lemma.

output_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonicalised inference output. Raw output is NEVER sent to Lemma.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds. Must be within ±300s of Lemma's server time (replay protection).

nonce.description: Optional 16-byte client nonce (hex) for additional replay protection.

claim_metadata.description: Optional metadata bound into the proof commitment as a hash; never stored in the clear.

agentId.description: Calling agent's DID. Recommended for full audit trail; combine with product A credential.

purpose.description: Human-readable purpose label. Hashed before commitment.

provider.description: Free-form provider identifier. Hashed before commitment.
